rule: generated worlds reuse installed mission scenes (product contract); a scene is usable when it is installed in an allowed module and meets its mission contract; nothing is inferred from scene names

battleTable.rule: GeneratedBattleTerrain.SceneTableSha over GameSceneDataManager.SingleplayerBattleScenes; the game refuses to use a catalogue whose table hash differs from the installed one

fieldBattle.evidence: MenuHelper.EncounterAttackConsequence -> DefaultSceneModel.GetBattleSceneForMapPatch(patch, false); the patch places the armies on the scene's spawn paths (TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.MBSceneUtilities.GetAllSpawnPaths: paths named spawn_path_*)

navalBattle.evidence: DefaultSceneModel.GetBattleSceneForMapPatch(patch, true): several naval scenes are filtered by Terrain == SandBox.MapScene.GetTerrainTypeAtPosition(MainParty.Position) (the GetEnvironmentTerrainTypesCount out value), then random; ships spawn on the spawn paths

settlementCenter.evidence: town and castle visits open center.GetSceneName(wall level) with DefaultLocationModel.GetUpgradeLevelTag(wall level) = level_N

siege.evidence: SandBox.SandBoxMissions.OpenSiegeMissionWithDeployment / OpenSiegeMissionNoDeployment: SceneLevels = LocationModel.GetUpgradeLevelTag(wall level) + " siege" on the center scene of that wall level

siegeLordsHall.evidence: SandBox.SandBoxMissions.OpenSiegeLordsHallFightMission: SceneLevels "siege" on the lord's hall scene

villageCenter.evidence: village visits open the village_center location scene; a land raid battle (PlayerEncounter.StartVillageBattleMission) opens GetScene("village_center", 1) with level "land_raid" when the scene has it (most installed village scenes do not; inventoried, not required)

navalRaid.evidence: NavalDLC.Missions.NavalMissions.OpenNavalRaidMission: the village's LocationComplex.GetScene("village_center") with SceneLevels "naval_raid"; NavalRaidMissionController.OnBehaviorInitialize collects the ships' landing points (tags landing(_\d+)*) and the troops' jumping points (jumping(_\d+)*); "player_spawn_frame" (the defending player) and the "attacker_"/"defender_" + formation spawn entities are used when present (NavalRaidMissionDeploymentPlanningLogic falls back otherwise)

hideout.evidence: SandBox.SandBoxMissions.OpenHideoutBattleMission: SceneLevels level_1/level_2; HideoutMissionController.InitializeMission and SpawnTroops take the CommonAreaMarker areas; SandBoxHelpers.SpawnPlayer uses "spawnpoint_player"

port.evidence: a port town's port location (War Sails shipyard) opens its port scene; only its installation is checked (no level or entity requirement was traced)

conversation.evidence: SandBox.SandBoxMissions.OpenConversationMission without a special scene -> DefaultSceneModel.GetConversationSceneForMapPosition(MainParty.Position): the most frequent terrain of GetEnvironmentTerrainTypesCount (57 samples), then a random conversation scene of that terrain, else a random one
